name: Antares
tagline: The rival of Mars — a bloated red supergiant nearing its supernova.
history: Antares — 'anti-Ares,' rivaling Mars's red glare — is a red supergiant so swollen that placed at the Sun it would swallow Mars's orbit. Its outer layers are already being flung off in a vast wind; VLTI images show chaotic convection cells boiling on its face. Within a few hundred thousand years its core will collapse into one of the closest supernovae ever seen by modern astronomy — a daytime-visible blaze rivaling the full Moon.
